settings.textarea_text: We cover what matters. Here's exactly what our warranty includes — and what it doesn't.

We cover what matters.
Your warranty includes protection against:

• Material defects
• Faulty zippers
• Stitching issues
• Structural faults

And it applies to a wide range of DICOTA products. The Lifetime Warranty covers the following product families:

ACTIVE, BASE, CODE, CORE, ECO, ECO BASE, ECO GO, ECO MOTION, ECO MOVE, ECO PRO, ECO SCALE, ECO SELECT, EDGE, E-SPORTS, FIVE, FLOW, GO, MOS, MOVE, PERFECT SKIN, PRO, SCALE, SELECT, SMART SKIN, SPIN, STYLE, TABLET, UNIVERSAL, URBAN

Even the best companions have their limits.
This warranty does not include:

• Normal wear and tear
• Misuse or improper handling
• Water damage
• Natural disasters
